funder_detail: JICA ODA loan for Phase 3(I) — JPY 81,060 million (of which JPY 45,000 million as tranche 1), commonly reported as ≈₹4,336 cr at contemporary exchange rates. This is JICA's LOAN amount for one phase, not BWSSB's total project cost for Cauvery Stage V as a whole — see project notes. JICA's own document states the wider Phase 3(I) project cost estimate as JPY 153,837 million (loan + non-loan components), which this site has not independently converted to INR.
